Squad: Class 1-A Together.description:
🤝 One evening before classes, and a delivery problem on the lawn is about to be everyone's business.

📍 Heights Alliance yard · move-in night
🎭 Group start: friends from the first night
👥 For Hero Course players together (Class 1-A or 1-B)
Squad: Class 1-A Together.storyStart:
THE SITUATION: It is Sunday evening, move-in day at U.A. Academy, the night before the first day of classes. Every student now lives at Heights Alliance: one five-story dorm per Hero Course class, the other courses in shared halls at the far end, and a curfew tonight and every night. Several player characters are first-years in the Hero Course, each in Class 1-A or Class 1-B as their path says. The canon classmates keep their seats, names and Quirks, and nobody remarks on class size. The PCs may know each other from the entrance exam, from home or not at all, as their Backgrounds say. Nobody in the yard knows what tomorrow's classes hold.
THE PLACE: Heights Alliance Yard: the lawn and walkways between the Hero Course dorms, the Class 1-A and Class 1-B buildings facing each other, the other courses' larger halls at the far end, and the path back to the Courtyard. The floodlights have just come on. Moving boxes stand stacked by the dorm doors, and a few residents sit out in the warm evening. Faculty walk rounds after dark, and anyone caught outside after curfew gets house arrest and cleaning duty.
THE MOMENT: A delivery truck has left a final load on the lawn and driven off: crates of furniture addressed to Momo Yaoyorozu, too large for the 1-A dorm's door, with curfew an hour away. Momo stands beside them apologizing to everyone. Mina Ashido has already turned one crate into a party table with snacks from the Dorm Kitchen, and from the 1-B side Neito Monoma has come out to watch and comment. Every PC is in the yard for a reason of their own (carrying a last box, invited to Mina's gathering, asked to help, out for air); show each of them with one visible detail before the crates need hands.
WHO MAY APPEAR:
- Momo Yaoyorozu: polite and precise, mortified that her family sent furniture fit for a mansion; she wants a plan that breaks no rule.
- Mina Ashido: the class mood-maker, turning the evening into a party and every new face into a friend.
- Tenya Iida: formal and loud about curfew, and about whether moving furniture with Quirks is permitted on campus.
- Katsuki Bakugo: annoyed by the noise under his window and by everyone making it.
- Eijiro Kirishima: first to offer to carry something heavy, friendly to all.
- Izuku Midoriya: anxious and helpful, muttering notes on everyone's Quirks.
- Itsuka Kendo and Neito Monoma: from 1-B; Kendo comes to help and to rein in Monoma, who needles 1-A about rivalry.
- Shota Aizawa or Vlad King: walking rounds after dark; Aizawa notes the time, Vlad King checks on 1-B at full volume.
Spotlight only those the scene needs; the rest stay indoors.
OPENING HOOKS:
- U.A. Hero Course (Class 1-A): the PC lives in this dorm, and the crates block its only door until somebody solves them.
- U.A. Hero Course (Class 1-B): the PC is on the 1-B side when Monoma starts on 1-A, and Kendo asks the PC to come along and keep it friendly.
- Hero Family: a relative's hero name is known in this yard, and Iida or Kendo recognizes it before the PC has given their own.
- Wealthy Family: the PC's own boxes came on the same truck, and Momo assumes the PC understands her embarrassment.
- Transformation: the PC's Quirk could lift a crate in one move, and Iida is already asking whether that counts as unsupervised Quirk use.
- Mutant: the PC's heteromorph body sets them apart in a yard of strangers, and Mina takes it as the best reason yet to introduce herself.
- Default: the PC is carrying a last box across the lawn when Mina hands them a soda and a seat at the crate table.
RULES:
- The scene stays in Heights Alliance Yard; the dorm lounges and rooms are other areas.
- Each PC's Quirk works exactly as their traits state; Quirk use on campus outside supervised training breaks the rules, and faculty treat it so.
- Each player acts and answers for themselves; no PC speaks for another, and no single PC is the lead.
- No canon event happens or is foretold tonight; tomorrow is only the first day.
- End on an open moment, the crates still on the lawn and curfew closing in.

THE FIRST DAYS (background for later turns; the opening stays on THE MOMENT):
- Weekdays run from the dorm kitchen to homeroom, morning lectures, Lunch Rush's line and afternoon Foundational Hero Studies on the training grounds. Evenings belong to the dorm: cooking and laundry rotas, the baths, homework at the long table, the Library, booked training, then curfew. Leaving campus means the sign-out sheet.
PEOPLE TO KNOW (how they treat a new classmate):
- Ochaco Uraraka asks where a newcomer is from; Tsuyu Asui says what she thinks and helps first; Shoto Todoroki keeps to himself and is puzzled when someone sits with him.
- Kyoka Jiro answers big talk with one deadpan line; Denki Kaminari chats and tries lines that never land; Hanta Sero jokes and offers a hand; Rikido Sato offers a snack.
- Fumikage Tokoyami, Mezo Shoji, Mashirao Ojiro and Koji Koda are grave, calm, polite and quiet in turn, and warm slowly.
- From 1-B: Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu shouts a challenge, Setsuna Tokage teases, Ibara Shiozaki bows, Pony Tsunotori asks in English when Japanese fails her.
- Across campus, Hitoshi Shinso of General Studies opens with a dry jab at the Hero Course, and Mei Hatsume of the Support Course asks about a Quirk before a name.
- Aizawa states a rule and its penalty, Vlad King cheers 1-B at full volume, and Recovery Girl scolds before she heals.
PARTY NOTES:
- Each PC has their own room, grades and relationships; a classmate who likes one PC owes nothing to the others.
- The group may split across the yard (the crates, Mina's table, the 1-B side, indoors); the narrator follows each in turn.
- PCs in different classes live in different buildings and meet as neighbors and rivals. Faculty sanction whoever they catch, not the group.
WHAT THE PCS CAN DO:
- Carry the crates by hand with Kirishima and anyone willing, or unpack the furniture and take it in piece by piece.
- Ask Aizawa or Vlad King for permission to use a Quirk, and live with the answer.
- Join Mina's table, keep Monoma's needling friendly, or go indoors and unpack.
Squad: Class 1-A Together.firstQuest: Make the first night at Heights Alliance count: get the yard sorted before curfew, and find out who these classmates and rivals really are.
Squad: Class 1-A Together.questGenerationGuidance: Favor the opening weeks of Hero Course life, shared by the group: classes and the faculty's tests, dorm evenings, curfew trouble, study sessions, training time that must be booked, the rivalry between Class 1-A and Class 1-B, General Studies students who resent the Hero Course, reporters at the Main Gate asking about All Might. Each member earns their own grades, rankings and reputation; help counts for the helper. Rivalries and friendships can grow inside the group as easily as with canon classmates. Canon events of the year happen only when their causes are in place, with every member free to change how they go; never schedule or foretell them. Keep danger rare at first and let the dorm become home. Dorm life is the group's home base: rotas, borrowed notes and late talks in the lounge grow friendships and grudges one evening at a time.
